params.name: deviceArn
params.description: ARN of the device, case sensitive (e.g. arn:aws:braket:us-east-1::device/qpu/ionq/Forte-1).

items.docs: Retrieve information about a single Amazon Braket device, including its provider, status (ONLINE / OFFLINE / RETIRED), queue size, and a JSON deviceCapabilities document describing supported gates, qubit topology, connectivity, paradigm, and calibration data.
Search the catalog of Amazon Braket devices available in the calling region. Supports filtering by provider name, device ARN, name, type, and status.
